description: P19: the placeholder stinger, so the music director's stinger path plays before the score lands. P19 shipped one default cue per family of the cue map (plan M6-M9 section 4.1); P21 replaced every sfx. cue with the effect banks (bank_combat, bank_abilities, bank_steps, bank_voices, bank_threat, bank_world, bank_ui) and removed them here. P23 replaces mus.stinger.default with the score's stingers and deletes this bank and assets/audio/placeholder/.
